title: macOS Restart Reminder (MRR)
description: Managed settings for the macOS restart reminder LaunchDaemon and swiftDialog UI.

Enabled.title: Enable Restart Reminder
Enabled.description: Turns the restart reminder workflow on or off. The LaunchDaemon remains installed but exits immediately when disabled.

PersistentWindow.title: Persistent Window
PersistentWindow.description: When enabled, the normal restart reminder stays on top, cannot be moved, uses protected keyboard dismissal behavior, and is automatically reopened if dismissed without choosing Restart Now or Snooze.

WindowWidth.title: Reminder Window Width
WindowWidth.description: Width of the normal restart reminder window in pixels.

WindowHeight.title: Reminder Window Height
WindowHeight.description: Height of the normal restart reminder window in pixels.

WindowTitleFont.title: Reminder Title Font
WindowTitleFont.description: swiftDialog title font parameters, for example: name=Helvetica Neue,size=28,weight=bold,colour=#000000

WindowMessageFont.title: Reminder Message Font
WindowMessageFont.description: swiftDialog message font parameters, for example: name=Helvetica Neue,size=14,colour=#000000

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Main restart reminder message shown to the user.
Message.default: Your Mac needs to restart to complete maintenance and remain secure. Please save your work and restart.

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: swiftDialog icon value. Example: SF=arrow.clockwise.circle.fill or a local file path.

Banner.title: Banner
Banner.description: Optional local path or supported swiftDialog banner image value.

ForceRestartWindowMessage.title: Final Forced Restart Message
ForceRestartWindowMessage.default: Your allowed restart deferrals have been used. Save your work now. This Mac will restart automatically when the countdown reaches zero.

ForceRestartWindowWidth.title: Forced Restart Window Width
ForceRestartWindowWidth.description: Width of the forced restart window in pixels.

ForceRestartWindowHeight.title: Forced Restart Window Height
ForceRestartWindowHeight.description: Height of the forced restart window in pixels.

ForceRestartWindowTitleFont.title: Forced Restart Title Font
ForceRestartWindowTitleFont.description: swiftDialog title font parameters, for example: name=Helvetica Neue,size=28,weight=bold,colour=#000000

ForceRestartWindowMessageFont.title: Forced Restart Message Font
ForceRestartWindowMessageFont.description: swiftDialog message font parameters, for example: name=Helvetica Neue,size=14,colour=#000000

CountDownTimer.title: Final Countdown Timer (seconds)
CountDownTimer.description: Number of seconds shown in the final forced restart window.

RestartIntervalDays.title: Restart Frequency (days)
RestartIntervalDays.description: Show the restart workflow after the Mac has been running this many full days. The minimum is one day.

SnoozeIntervalHours.title: Snooze Interval (hours)
SnoozeIntervalHours.description: How long to wait before prompting again after a snooze.

CheckDNDOrMeeting.title: Check Active Meeting
CheckDNDOrMeeting.description: Defers normal reminders when a supported conferencing app is running and an active microphone or conferencing power assertion is detected. DND/Focus is ignored. The legacy key name is retained for profile compatibility. Does not defer the final forced restart.

IgnoreMeetingDuringForceRestart.title: Ignore Meeting During Force Restart
IgnoreMeetingDuringForceRestart.description: When enabled, the forced restart countdown proceeds even during an active meeting. When disabled, forced restart waits and checks again every five minutes until the meeting ends.

LogFileLocation.title: Log File Location
LogFileLocation.description: Absolute log filename directly under /var/log. Subdirectories and other locations are rejected for security.
